name: promotion_pipeline_default
description: Default gates for promoting a research candidate into an Alpaca paper-trading candidate.
promotion_notes: Candidate rules must be captured in the strategy research catalog or equivalent notes.
Backtest data must pass quality and result-validation gates.
Candidate must have either benchmark-relative evidence or a replication pass.
Walk-forward governance must pass before the final holdout parameters can become the paper manifest parameters.
Capacity and cost stress must pass at the minimum paper capital level.
